content.text:
K3D_CLUSTER_NAME ?= sch-local
K3D_CONTEXT ?= k3d-$(K3D_CLUSTER_NAME)
K3D_REGISTRY_NAME ?= sch-registry.localhost
K3D_REGISTRY_PORT ?= 5001
K3D_REGISTRY_REF ?= k3d-$(K3D_REGISTRY_NAME):$(K3D_REGISTRY_PORT)
REGISTRY_PUSH_HOST ?= localhost:$(K3D_REGISTRY_PORT)

PLATFORM_ENV ?= local
PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE ?= sch-platform-infra
PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE ?= sch-platform-services
PLATFORM_NAMESPACE ?= sch-local
PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT ?= 20m
SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE ?= service-desk
PLATFORM_CNPG_CLUSTER_NAME ?= sch-cnpg
PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT ?= 20m
PLATFORM_REGISTRY_RELEASE ?= harbor
PLATFORM_REGISTRY_NAMESPACE ?= harbor

ADDONS_MANIFEST ?= cluster_addons/environments/$(PLATFORM_ENV)/cluster_addons.yaml
ADDONS_MANAGER ?= cluster_addons/manage_releases.py
STACK_RUNNER ?= stack_runner.py
STACK_FILE ?= environments/$(PLATFORM_ENV)/stack.yaml
STACK_RUNNER_ENV = HELM="$(HELM)" KUBECTL="$(KUBECTL)" PYTHON="$(PYTHON)" STACK_NAMESPACE="$(PLATFORM_NAMESPACE)" STACK_RELEASE_INFRA="$(PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE)" STACK_RELEASE_SERVICES="$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE)" STACK_RELEASE_SERVICE_DESK="$(SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE)" STACK_TIMEOUT_INFRA="$(PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT)" STACK_TIMEOUT_SERVICES="$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT)" STACK_TIMEOUT_SERVICE_DESK="$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_HELM_TIMEOUT)"

IMAGE_SCRIPT ?= images/build_and_push_local.sh
HOSTING_CHARTS_SCRIPT ?= publish_hosting_charts.py
HOSTING_CHARTS_DIR ?= ../../../hosting_apps
HARBOR_REGISTRY_HOST ?= apps-registry.localdev.me
HARBOR_PROJECT ?= smartcityhub
HARBOR_USERNAME ?= admin
HARBOR_PASSWORD_SECRET ?= harbor/harbor-core:HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD
HARBOR_PLAIN_HTTP ?= true
SMOKE_SCRIPT ?= smoke_local.py
KUBECTL ?= kubectl
PYTHON ?= python3
HELM ?= $(shell if command -v helm >/dev/null 2>&1 && helm version --short 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^v3\.'; then echo helm; elif command -v helm3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo helm3; elif command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then p="$$(brew --prefix helm@3 2>/dev/null)/bin/helm"; if [ -x "$$p" ]; then echo "$$p"; fi; fi)

.DEFAULT_GOAL := help

.PHONY: help install-docker-macos install-tools-macos install-prereqs-macos doctor doctor-render doctor-smoke registry-create registry-delete cluster-create cluster-delete cluster-start cluster-stop cluster-status kubeconfig-show lens-hint images-build-push hosting-charts-build-push addons-install addons-uninstall stack-list stack-render render-check infrastructure-install infrastructure-uninstall core-apps-install core-apps-uninstall platform-install platform-uninstall smoke-local local-up local-down local-reset

help:
	@printf "%s\n" \
		"Usage:" \
		"  make <target>" \
		"" \
		"Main local workflow:" \
		"  make install-prereqs-macos   # optional, installs Docker Desktop + k3d/kubectl/Helm 3 via Homebrew" \
		"  make local-up                # create registry + cluster, build/push images, install add-ons, infra, services, and enabled core apps" \
		"  make stack-list              # list releases and profiles from environments/<env>/stack.yaml" \
		"  make stack-render            # render the selected stack.yaml without touching a cluster" \
		"  make render-check            # render-check the local stack definition" \
		"  make hosting-charts-build-push # build/package/push hosting app Helm charts into Harbor" \
		"  make infrastructure-install  # install or update the infrastructure stack profile" \
		"  make infrastructure-uninstall # uninstall the infrastructure stack profile" \
		"  make core-apps-install       # install or update the core-apps stack profile" \
		"  make core-apps-uninstall     # uninstall the core-apps stack profile" \
		"  make platform-install        # install the full runtime stack profile" \
		"  make smoke-local             # run a local smoke test across add-ons, platform, CNPG and migrations" \
		"  make cluster-status          # inspect local cluster and releases" \
		"  make kubeconfig-show         # show the kubeconfig path and the expected local context" \
		"  make lens-hint               # print the recommended Lens workflow for the local cluster" \
		"  make local-down              # uninstall Helm releases from the cluster" \
		"  make local-reset             # uninstall releases, delete cluster and local registry" \
		"" \
		"Useful variables:" \
		"  PLATFORM_ENV=$(PLATFORM_ENV)" \
		"  K3D_CLUSTER_NAME=$(K3D_CLUSTER_NAME)" \
		"  K3D_REGISTRY_REF=$(K3D_REGISTRY_REF)" \
		"  REGISTRY_PUSH_HOST=$(REGISTRY_PUSH_HOST)" \
		"  HARBOR_REGISTRY_HOST=$(HARBOR_REGISTRY_HOST)" \
		"  HARBOR_PROJECT=$(HARBOR_PROJECT)" \
		"  PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_INFRA_RELEASE)" \
		"  PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE=$(PLATFORM_SERVICES_RELEASE)" \
		"  PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT=$(PLATFORM_INFRA_HELM_TIMEOUT)" \
		"  SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE=$(SERVICE_DESK_RELEASE)" \
		"  PLATFORM_CNPG_CLUSTER_NAME=$(PLATFORM_CNPG_CLUSTER_NAME)" \
		"  STACK_FILE=$(STACK_FILE)" \
		"  STACK_RUNNER=$(STACK_RUNNER)" \
		"  HELM=$(if $(HELM),$(HELM),<not found>)" \
		"" \
		"Examples:" \
		"  HELM=$$(brew --prefix helm@3)/bin/helm make local-up" \
		"  HELM=$$(brew --prefix helm@3)/bin/helm make smoke-local" \
		"  $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) install $(STACK_FILE) --profile services" \
		"  $(PYTHON) $(STACK_RUNNER) install $(STACK_FILE) --release core-service-desk" \
		"  REGISTRY_HOST=$(REGISTRY_PUSH_HOST) IMAGE_NAMESPACE=sch TAG=local $(IMAGE_SCRIPT) portal-backend pyway-migrate" \
		"  $(PYTHON) $(ADDONS_MANAGER) install $(ADDONS_MANIFEST)" \
		"  HELM=$(HELM) KUBECTL=$(KUBECTL) $(PYTHON) $(SMOKE_SCRIPT)"

install-docker-macos:
	@if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
		echo "Homebrew is required for this target."; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	brew install --cask docker-desktop
	@printf "%s\n" \
		"Docker Desktop was installed via Homebrew." \
		"Start Docker Desktop once manually, then wait until 'docker info' succeeds."
